description: This file contains unit tests for the JsonSchemaVersion class, verifying its immutability and behavior of the forInt() method with known and unknown version integers.

classes.name: JsonSchemaVersionTest
classes.description: Unit tests for JsonSchemaVersion, including immutability and version retrieval logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that JsonSchemaVersion class instances are immutable, with additional assertion on Predicate immutability.

methods.name: getSchemaVersionForUnknownVersionIntReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies that for an unknown version integer (-1), the method returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: getSchemaVersionForKnownVersionIntReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that for a known version integer (1), the method returns the expected JsonSchemaVersion constant (V_1).
